'''Dorlan''' is a small village to the East of [[Tar Valon]]. Dorlan is the traditional, exclusive source of cheese for the [[White Tower]].{{ref/book|10|3}}

The mayor of Dorlan is [[Garon Burlow]]. The village consists of fifteen houses, a village green and a cow barn for each house.

== Activities ==
When [[Covarla Baldene]] and eleven [[Aes Sedai]] escaped from the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] to secretly return to the [[White Tower]] to tell [[Elaida]] about the events, the [[Amyrlin]] sends them along the [[Younglings]] to the small village of Dorlan in order to hide the disaster from the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]]. While the sisters are hosted in the houses, the [[Younglings]] are living in the barns. During this time, [[Tarna Feir]] and [[Katerine Alruddin]] come and go from the village, taking spare, and not-so-spare, rooms from the residents.

[[Gawyn Trakand]] is leading his Younglings in Dorlan when they are caught there during the [[Siege of Tar Valon]]. Elaida orders them to start a guerilla campaign against the [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Rebel]]'s army; in that they are helped by the sisters hiding in Dorlan. Gawyn continues to use Dorlan as his main base of operations for the Younglings to harry the Rebel's forces.

When the loyalists learn the [[Travel]] weaves from [[Beonin]]'s betrayal, Katerine returns to Dorlan to teach them the weave so they can use the it in their guerilla actions. While there Katerine reveals also to Gawyn the fate of [[Egwene]], so Gawyn leaves Dorlan definitively to reach the Rebel's Army.
